title: Action.run accepts its declared input and no separate schema argument
notes: specification/durable-execution.mdx, 'Action': 'Source authors MUST NOT repeat Action types as separate schema arguments' — schemas are compiler-derived from the one typed signature. The obligation is discharged by the durable frontend's own arity rule: Action.run has no schema parameter, and a second argument is refused as VIBE4113 at the call rather than silently ignored. Silently ignoring it is the fail-open this case exists for — an author who believes the schema argument did something ships a program whose real schema is the derived one. A policy-bag second argument is also the most likely accidental spelling for an author arriving from other durable frameworks.
